Event Description: The first suspect developed symptoms (index case). Probable start of the transmission chain.
Death of the first suspect case.
The second suspect case (sibling/companion) developed symptoms.
Samples sent to the INRB Kinshasa.
Alert notified, awaiting verification. Etiology: filovirus. Virus Ebola Zaire ruled out.
Alert on social media: ~50 deaths in Mongbwalu.
Uganda declares an epidemic due to an imported case. (The Ministry of Health of Uganda confirmed 1 imported case of BDBV).
Genomic sequencing confirms the Ebola virus Bundibugyo. Event classified as EVD (Ebola Virus Disease) species Bundibugyo.
INRB Kinshasa confirms the Ebola virus (non-Zaire species).
The first sequencing of positive samples confirms the Ebola virus Bundibugyo.
